menu.name: About this workspace
menu.content:
A workspace for the whole job

Conversation directs the work. The project record holds the facts, evidence, options, decisions, and outputs that build toward a finished job.

Understand the property and explore alternatives.
Resolve technical questions, then prepare scope and dependencies.
Coordinate resources, guide execution, and keep the handover record.
What is real here

Local persistence alongside source files, project switching, revision history, decisions, stale-output detection and workflow checkpoints.

What is simulated

The general agent conversation and workflow demonstrations still use labeled fixtures. Muse photo observations and planning questions are real model proposals. Technical review, live pricing, professional approval and physical-work release remain unavailable.

Open the earlier preview
